git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Worktree already contains fix - MCP SDK >=1.27 rejects reuse of already-connected transport
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Original code created a single McpServer + StreamableHTTPServerTransport at startup and reused it for all requests. MCP SDK >=1.27 throws error on second connect() to same transport.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Per-request pattern: each HTTP request creates a fresh McpServer + StreamableHTTPServerTransport, connects, handles, then closes. This is the stateless StreamableHTTP pattern recommended by MCP SDK.
